title: Soap Dish Wall Mount 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Matte White | Brass Soap Dishes | Allied Brass
short_title: Soap Dish Wall Mount 4.5-Inch, Matte White
description:
Keep bar soap off the countertop and finish your sink area with a clean, coordinated look in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. This wall-mount soap dish frees up space at the vanity while adding a distinctive detail that fits transitional bathroom hardware styles.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built for everyday use: made of solid brass for durable bathroom performance
- Coordinate your bath: part of the Brass Soap Dishes collection for a pulled-together accessory set
- Match your décor: available in a variety of designer finishes for versatile bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: wall mounted soap dish
- Material: solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 3 x 3.5 inches
- Shipping weight: 2 lbs
- Assembly: assembled in the U.S.A.
